questions: In what order does the server activate the BSP-created entity list and start load-time outputs?
What exact state does CAI_BaseNPC::NPCInitThink establish before ordinary RunAI?
Which initial activity, schedule, motor yaw, navigator, visibility and think fields are written?
Does initial native work depend on entity-lump order or an independently scheduled think deadline?
Which CLogicAuto path produces OnMapLoad and where does it cross into CEventQueue?

findings.fact: LevelInit constructs and keyvalues map entities before DispatchSpawn, deferring parented entities; ServerActivate is a later complete live-entity pass.
findings.evidence: 0x1011a7a0 -> 0x10136b40/0x101d1280; 0x1011aaf0 walks the live entity list and invokes vtable +0x1c4.
findings.consequence: Creation, Spawn and Activate remain distinct ordered phases.

findings.fact: Jack's npc_VVampire concrete Spawn reaches the Human/Troika and CAI_BaseNPC spawn bodies, then caches its live transform.
findings.consequence: The BSP origin and angles are real spawn inputs, not a dialogue placement request.

findings.fact: The traced Jack Spawn, Activate and concrete NPCInitThink path contains no turn-to-player and no direct SetActivity or SetIdealActivity call.
findings.evidence: 0x103c4ef0, 0x10298d30, 0x10273200, 0x1028e310, 0x10273aa0, base 0x10273ad0, Troika override 0x1029a8b0 and closest-player join 0x101828b0 were decompiled; 0x101a6540 is the empty base +0x694 virtual.
findings.consequence: Do not invent a spawn-time idle or facing command; capture the first visible sequence and later AI/gaze behavior.

findings.fact: CLogicAuto Spawn installs a delayed think deadline rather than firing OnMapLoad inside entity parsing.
findings.evidence: CLogicAuto vtable +0x19c -> 0x10130d10 writes current time plus the class delay to the next-think field.
findings.consequence: Map-load outputs occur after direct character construction and Spawn.
